# HH FABTECH

> HH FABTECH is a manufacturer of petroleum, diesel, chemical, stainless steel and water tankers, fuel bowsers and industrial storage tanks, based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. The company builds custom-engineered, quality-tested tankers for industries across India, with fabrication expertise dating back to 1967.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://hhfabtech.com/): Company overview, product range and why to choose HH FABTECH.
- [About Us](https://hhfabtech.com/about): Company history since 1967, manufacturing capability and values.
- [Products](https://hhfabtech.com/products): Full product range index with links to each product.
- [Contact Us](https://hhfabtech.com/contact): Factory address in Ahmedabad, phone, email and inquiry form.

## Products

- [Petroleum / Diesel Tanker](https://hhfabtech.com/petroleum-tanker): Fuel tankers for IOCL, HPCL, Jio-bp, Nayara and Essar, 12 KL to 40 KL, top and bottom loading, custom compartments.
- [Chemical Tanker](https://hhfabtech.com/chemical-tanker): Corrosion-resistant tankers for acids (HCL, H2SO4, HNO3) and hazardous liquids, 10 to 20 ton.
- [SS Tanker](https://hhfabtech.com/ss-tanker): Food-grade SS304 and SS316 stainless steel tankers for milk, edible oil, pharma and chemicals.
- [Fuel Bowser](https://hhfabtech.com/fuel-bowser): Mobile diesel dispensing units, 500 L to 5000 L, with pump, meter and nozzle options.
- [Storage Tank](https://hhfabtech.com/storage-tank): Vertical and capsule storage tanks, 5 KL to 40 KL, for petroleum, water, chemicals and industrial liquids.
- [Water Tanker](https://hhfabtech.com/water-tanker): Water tankers for municipal, construction, industrial and agriculture use, 5 KL to 20 KL, MS and SS.

## Tools

- [Tank Volume Calculator](https://hhfabtech.com/calculator): Free tank volume and partial-fill calculator for horizontal, vertical, oval, Spell, cone, capsule, spherical, dished-end and rectangular tanks, in litres, KL, m³ and gallons, with a live 2D and 3D model, formulas, baffle planning and steel weight estimate.
